# bst260project-template

Instructions and template for projects for 2026 HSPH BST260

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cdcmurd`](https://github.com/vjcitn/bst260project-template/reference/cdcmurd.md)
  : data from CDC on homicide rates by state by year
- [`gunleg`](https://github.com/vjcitn/bst260project-template/reference/gunleg.md)
  : data from RAND corporation on historical record of state
  legislatures actions on firearms control
- [`waterborne`](https://github.com/vjcitn/bst260project-template/reference/waterborne.md)
  : data from CDC on waterborne and foodborne illness events
